newsitem.title: USA: Interstate General to restructure as REIT.
newsitem.headline: Interstate General to restructure as REIT.

text.p: Interstate General Co LP said Wednesday it will pursue a restructuring plan that will transform it from a master limited partnership into a real estate investment trust (REIT).
The company said the plan is a modification of one originally announced in December.

Under the new plan, the company's investment apartment properties and land development assets would be placed into an entity, American Community Properties Trust (ACPT), that would benefit from the rules that govern REITs, and raise about $40 million through a securities offering.
IGC said it wants a structure better accepted by Wall Street than the master limited partnership, and hopes to accomplish the change in the third quarter of 1997.
ACPT would not, said the company, receive several IGC subsidiaries that do not qualify for a REIT, two of which have posted losses for the past several years.
And ACPT would not be encumbered by the expenses and liabilities related to IGC's four felony convictions for wetlands violations on commercial property in St. Charles, Md.
A final detailed restructuring plan is subject to approvals from IGC unitholders, said the company, its outsdie shareholders, certain government agencies and creditors.
